config.label: Custom User-Agent string for USGS NWIS and OGC discovery endpoints
config.description: Custom User-Agent string for USGS NWIS and OGC discovery endpoints. Defaults to a descriptive identifier including the repo URL.

config.label: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for USGS NWIS and OGC calls
config.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for USGS NWIS and OGC calls. Site-series discovery also has a shared 45-second deadline. Default: 30000.

config.label: Set to true to make water_dataframe_drop callable — it removes one staged table from a DataCanvas
config.description: Set to true to make water_dataframe_drop callable — it removes one staged table from a DataCanvas. Off by default, which lists the tool as disabled. Needs CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb to have anything to drop.

config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
